select  
     p.id ,
     p.numberofcredit,
     p.creditlineamount,                                  
     p.annualyinterestrate,                                          
     p.dateofconclusion ,                                            
     p.duedatefirstcontract,                                      
     p.duedatelastcontract,                                       
     p.purposeofcredit,                                           
     p.annualypenaltyrate, 
     p.intcalcmethod ,
     p.branchid,
     cat.description, 
     h.rest,
     h.rest*o.ostat  AS ekrest,
     h.interestrest ,
     h.interestrest*o.ostat AS ekint,
     h.duerest,
     h.duerest*o.ostat AS ekduerest,
     h.dueinterestrest,
     h.dueinterestrest*o.ostat as ekdueint,
     h.penaltyrest ,                 
     h.penaltyrest*o.ostat as ekpen,
     h.givenamount ,
     h.givenamount *o.ostat as  ekgivenamount,
     h.pledgeprice,
     h.stopcalcdate,
     e1.percent,
     e2.percent as duepercent,
     acc.acc_no as contractaccno,
     substr(acc.acc_no,0,4) as balaccno,
     intacc.acc_no as interestaccno,
     resacc.acc_no as reserveaccno,
     dueacc.acc_no as duecontractaccno,
     dueintacc.acc_no as dueinterestaccno,
     dueresacc.acc_no as duereserveaccno ,
     booroweracc.acc_no as booroweraccno,
     boorowerrest.ostat as boorrest,
     boorowerrest.ostat*o.ostat as eboorrest,
     av.val_name,
     l.name,
     LastintPaydate.paydat as lastintpaydate ,
     LastMainPaydate.paydat as lastmainpaydate ,
    -- cm_common.get_lastintpaydate (p.ID, :hdat) as lastintpaydate,
    -- cm_common.get_lastmainpaydate (p.ID, :hdat) as lastmainpaydate,
	 restpr.principal ,
	 restpr.interest,
	 Paydat.paymentdate as  paymentdateofReportDat,
     g.pledgename, 
	 g.holdername, 
	   g.registryno,
       g.anyinfotodisting                
                         ,
       g.registryagency                             
                       ,
       g.registrydate                                      
                     ,
       g.insuranceamount                                 
                        ,
       g.insurancedate , 
                                      
       l.boorowerid, 
       l.address, 
       l.phonenumber,	 
       pl.description,
       ps.name as psname,
       crdtypes.DESCRIPTION as credittype /*,
       ins.name as  insuranceagency*/
from cm_portfolio p,
     cm_history h,
     cm_categories cat,
     cm_boorowerinfo l,
     cm_guarantee g,
     --cm_insuranceagency ins,
     cm_pledges pl,
     cm_pledgsorts ps,
     sb_avalute av,
     sb_operkurs o,
     cm_credittypes crdtypes, 
   cm_loanaccounts acc,
   cm_intaccounts intacc,
   cm_reserveaccounts resacc,
   cm_dueloanaccounts dueacc ,
   cm_dueintaccounts dueintacc ,
   cm_dueresaccounts dueresacc  ,
   cm_booroweraccounts booroweracc,
   cm_boorowerrest boorowerrest,
   cm_reserve_types e1,
   cm_reserve_types e2 ,

(SELECT 0 AS principal,0 AS interest, creditid
  FROM (SELECT ID AS creditid
          FROM cm_portfolio
        MINUS
        SELECT creditid
          FROM cm_payment_schedule
         WHERE paymentdate BETWEEN to_date(:bdat)
                               AND to_date(:edat))
UNION
SELECT sum(principal),sum(interest), creditid
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE paymentdate BETWEEN to_date(:bdat)
                       AND to_date(:edat)
					   group by creditid) restpr,
                       
      ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat
        from cm_portfolio
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat from cm_payments
      where PAYEDINTAMT<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid)
      union
      select 
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat from cm_payments
      where PAYEDINTAMT<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid) LastintPaydate,

     
      ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat
        from cm_portfolio
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat from cm_payments
      where payedamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid)
      union
      select 
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat from cm_payments
      where payedamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid) LastMainPaydate ,
	  

(SELECT creditid, NULL AS paymentdate
  FROM (SELECT ID AS creditid
          FROM cm_portfolio
        MINUS
        SELECT   creditid
            FROM cm_payment_schedule
           WHERE paymentdate BETWEEN TO_DATE (   '01'
                                              || '-'
                                              || TO_CHAR (TO_DATE (:hdat),
                                                          'MON'
                                                         )
                                              || '-'
                                              || TO_CHAR (TO_DATE (:hdat),
                                                          'YYYY'
                                                         )
                                             )
                                 AND LAST_DAY (TO_DATE (:hdat))
        GROUP BY creditid)
UNION
SELECT creditid, MIN (paymentdate) AS paymentdate
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE paymentdate BETWEEN TO_DATE (   '01'
                                    || '-'
                                    || TO_CHAR (TO_DATE (:hdat), 'MON')
                                    || '-'
                                    || TO_CHAR (TO_DATE (:hdat), 'YYYY')
                                   )
                       AND LAST_DAY (TO_DATE (:hdat))
					   group by creditid) Paydat     
        

where 
  h.creditid = p.id 
  and e1.id = h.reserveid
  and e2.id = h.duereserveid
  and h.hdate = :hdat
  and cat.id = p.customertype
  and p.id = l.creditid(+)
  and p.id = g.creditid(+)
  and pl.id(+) = g.pledgeid
  --and ins.id = g.insuranceagency
  and ps.id(+) = p.pledgsorts
  and crdtypes.id = p.credittype
  and av.valute = p.currency
  and o.dat = :hdat
  and o.val_kod = p.currency
  and  p.id = acc.creditid 
  and  p.id = intacc.creditid 
  and  p.id = resacc.creditid 
  and  p.id = dueacc.creditid  
  and  p.id = dueintacc.creditid  
  and  p.id = dueresacc.creditid 
  and  p.id = booroweracc.creditid
  and  p.id = boorowerrest.creditid
  and restpr.creditid = p.id 
  and LastintPaydate.creditid = p.id
  and LastMainPaydate.creditid = p.id
  and p.id = Paydat.Creditid

datasets.sql:
select     p.id , p.numberofcredit,p.creditlineamount,p.annualyinterestrate,l.pincode,
g1.guarantorname,g1.zaminwork1,g1.zamintel1,g1.zmtelmob1,g1.guarantorid guarantorid1,
g2.guarantorname name2,g2.zaminwork1 wr2,g2.zamintel1 evtel2,g2.zmtelmob1 mobtel2,g2.guarantorid guarantorid2,
g3.guarantorname name3,g3.zaminwork1 wr3,g3.zamintel1 evtel3,g3.zmtelmob1 mobtel3,g3.guarantorid guarantorid3,
(select sum(payedamt)+sum(payedintamt)+sum(payeddueamt)+sum(payeddueintamt)+sum(payedpenaltyamt) pay from cm_payments
where PAYDATE  BETWEEN  ( 01|| '-'|| TO_CHAR (:hdat, 'MON')|| '-'|| TO_CHAR (:hdat, 'YYYY'))and last_day(:hdat) and creditid=p.id) caripay,                                          
     p.dateofconclusion , p.info, h.dueday,                                        
     p.duedatefirstcontract,  (select sum(payedamt)+sum(payeddueamt)pay from cm_payments where creditid=p.id) cemesas ,                                  
     p.duedatelastcontract,   (select sum(payedintamt)+sum(payeddueintamt) pay from cm_payments where creditid=p.id) cemfaiz,                                     
     p.purposeofcredit,
     p.annualypenaltyrate,(select name  from cm_tesnifat where id=p.tesnifid) tesnif,
     p.intcalcmethod ,(select name from vid_sob where cust_type in(1,-1) and id=l.vid_sob) fsektor,
     f.name as fliname,(SELECT name FROM otrasli where id=l.otid) otlasi,
     cat.description, 
     h.rest,(select description from cm_automation where id=p.autopayment) autopay,
     h.rest*o.ostat  AS ekrest,
     h.interestrest as interestrest ,
     h.interestrest*o.ostat as  ekint,
     h.duerest,
     h.duerest*o.ostat AS ekduerest,
     h.dueinterestrest as dueinterestrest,
     h.dueinterestrest*o.ostat as ekdueint,
     h.penaltyrest ,                 
     h.penaltyrest*o.ostat as ekpen,
     h.givenamount ,
     h.givenamount *o.ostat as  ekgivenamount,
     h.pledgeprice,
     h.stopcalcdate,
     e1.percent,
     e2.percent as duepercent,
     acc.acc_no as contractaccno,
     substr(acc.acc_no,9,5) as balaccno,
     intacc.acc_no as interestaccno,
     resacc.acc_no as reserveaccno,
     dueacc.acc_no as duecontractaccno,
     dueintacc.acc_no as dueinterestaccno,
     dueresacc.acc_no as duereserveaccno ,
     booroweracc.acc_no as booroweraccno,
     boorowerrest.ostat as boorrest,
     boorowerrest.ostat*o.ostat as eboorrest,
     av.val_name,
     l.name,
     LastintPaydate.paydat as lastintpaydate ,dLastintPaydate.paydat as dlastintpaydate ,
     LastMainPaydate.paydat as lastmainpaydate , dLastMainPaydate.paydat as dlastmainpaydate ,
    -- cm_common.get_lastintpaydate (p.ID, :hdat) as lastintpaydate,
    -- cm_common.get_lastmainpaydate (p.ID, :hdat) as lastmainpaydate,
     restpr.principal ,
     restpr.interest,
     Paydat.paymentdate as  paymentdateofReportDat,
     g.pledgename, 
     g.holdername, g.aftono,
       g.registryno,
       g.anyinfotodisting ,               
     ( select trunc(MONTHS_BETWEEN(p.dateofconclusion,max(birthday))/12) from custinfo where IDCUST=p.boorowerid)yash,     
       g.registryagency                             
                       ,
       g.registrydate                                
                     ,(select name from cm_aim_cred where id=p.aim_id)aim,
       g.insuranceamount  ,g.insuranceright ,
                    
       g.insurancedate , 
       --g.insuranceagency,                                   
       l.boorowerid, (select name  from cm_partniyor where id=p.partid) part,
       l.address, (select description from cm_usergroups where id=p.usrgroup) shert,(select name  from cm_qovluq where id=p.qovid) qovluq,
       l.phonenumber,l.salary,   pl.description,     
       ps.name as psname,acc.bal_cn1,
       crdtypes.DESCRIPTION as credittype ,cm_common.get_monthpay(p.id) as monthpay,
       ins.name as  insuranceagency,cm_common.get_custMONTHLYPROFIT(p.boorowerid) as MONTHLYPROFIT ,
       CM_RPORT.get_cred(p.creditact) as "Borcalanin sektoru",CM_RPORT.get_actives(p.activities) as "Borcalanin faliyyeti",cat.description as "Borcalanin faliyyet novu",
       CM_RPORT.get_vid_sob(p.activities_type)as "Mulkiyyet novu"/*,p.portfel*/,cm_credit.expert(p.EXPERTID) expert
from cm_portfolio p,smart.filial_t f,
     cm_history h,
     cm_categories cat,CM_GUARANTOR g1,CM_GUARANTOR g2,CM_GUARANTOR g3,
     cm_boorowerinfo l,
     cm_guarantee g,
     cm_insuranceagency ins,
     cm_pledges pl,
     cm_pledgsorts ps,
     avalute av,
     operkurs o,
     cm_credittypes crdtypes, 
   cm_loanaccounts acc,
   cm_intaccounts intacc,
   cm_reserveaccounts resacc,
   cm_dueloanaccounts dueacc ,
   cm_dueintaccounts dueintacc ,
   cm_dueresaccounts dueresacc  ,
   cm_booroweraccounts booroweracc,
   cm_boorowerrest boorowerrest,
   cm_reserve_types e1,
   cm_reserve_types e2 ,

(SELECT 0 AS principal,0 AS interest, creditid
  FROM (SELECT ID AS creditid
          FROM cm_portfolio
        MINUS
        SELECT creditid
          FROM cm_payment_schedule
         WHERE paymentdate BETWEEN to_date(:bdat)
                               AND to_date(:edat))
UNION
SELECT sum(principal),sum(interest), creditid
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE paymentdate BETWEEN to_date(:bdat)
                       AND to_date(:edat)
                       group by creditid) restpr,
                       
      ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat
        from cm_portfolio
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat from cm_payments
      where PAYEDINTAMT<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid)
      union
      select 
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat from cm_payments
      where PAYEDINTAMT<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid) LastintPaydate,

     
      ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat
        from cm_portfolio
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat from cm_payments
      where payedamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid)
      union
      select 
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat from cm_payments
      where payedamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid) LastMainPaydate ,
      
                       
      ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat
        from cm_portfolio
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat from cm_payments
      where payeddueintamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid)
      union
      select 
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat from cm_payments
      where payeddueintamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid) dLastintPaydate,

     
      ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat
        from cm_portfolio
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat from cm_payments
      where payeddueamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid)
      union
      select 
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat from cm_payments
      where payeddueamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE <= :hdat
      group by creditid) dLastMainPaydate ,
(SELECT creditid, NULL AS paymentdate
  FROM (SELECT ID AS creditid
          FROM cm_portfolio
        MINUS
        SELECT   creditid
            FROM cm_payment_schedule
           WHERE paymentdate BETWEEN TO_DATE (   '01'
                                              || '-'
                                              || TO_CHAR (TO_DATE (:hdat),
                                                          'MON'
                                                         )
                                              || '-'
                                              || TO_CHAR (TO_DATE (:hdat),
                                                          'YYYY'
                                                         )
                                             )
                                 AND LAST_DAY (TO_DATE (:hdat))
        GROUP BY creditid)
UNION
SELECT creditid, MIN (paymentdate) AS paymentdate
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE paymentdate BETWEEN TO_DATE (   '01'
                                    || '-'
                                    || TO_CHAR (TO_DATE (:hdat), 'MON')
                                    || '-'
                                    || TO_CHAR (TO_DATE (:hdat), 'YYYY')
                                   )
                       AND LAST_DAY (TO_DATE (:hdat))
                       group by creditid) Paydat     
        

where 
  h.creditid = p.id  and f.id=p.branchid  and p.id=g1.creditid(+) and g1.cardid(+)=1
  and e1.id(+) = h.reserveid             and p.id=g2.creditid(+) and g2.cardid(+)=2
  and e2.id(+) = h.duereserveid          and p.id=g3.creditid(+) and g3.cardid(+)=3
  and h.hdate = :hdat
  and cat.id = p.customertype
  and p.id = l.creditid
  and p.id = g.creditid(+)
  and pl.id(+) = g.pledgeid
  and ins.id(+) = g.insuranceagency
  and ps.id(+) = g.pledgsorts
  and crdtypes.id = p.credittype
  and av.valute = p.currency
  and o.dat = :hdat
  and o.val_kod = p.currency
  and  p.id = acc.creditid 
  and  p.id = intacc.creditid 
  and  p.id = resacc.creditid 
  and  p.id = dueacc.creditid  
  and  p.id = dueintacc.creditid
  and  p.id = dueresacc.creditid 
  and  p.id = booroweracc.creditid
  and  p.id = boorowerrest.creditid
  and restpr.creditid(+) = p.id
  and LastintPaydate.creditid(+) = p.id
  and LastMainPaydate.creditid(+) = p.id  and dLastintPaydate.creditid = p.id and dLastMainPaydate.creditid(+) = p.id
  and p.id = Paydat.Creditid(+)
 -- and p.creditact=ca.id and ac.id =p.activities and p.activities_type=act.act_id
